newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh interbank trade uncertain due to strike.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh interbank trade uncertain due to strike.

text.p: Trading in Bangladesh's interbank market is uncertain on Tuesday due to a nationwide strike called by Islamist groups, dealers said.

The groups, backed by the main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), called the strike to protest against a Jewish woman in Israel who put up posters two weeks ago that depicted the Prophet Mohammad as a pig.
The groups said the action ridiculed the revered Mohammad.
"Most dealers are absent. Transactions are very much unlikely," said one dealer. The Bangladesh taka closed at 43.7650/7700 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday.
